'''''Thymus lotocephalus''''' ([[Portuguese language|Portuguese]]: {{lang|pt|erva-ursa}}) is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the mint family [[Lamiaceae]], [[endemic]] to southern [[Portugal]], specifically central [[Algarve]]. It inhabits both the coast and the interior (Barrocal). On the coast it is found in pine forest clearings and xerophilic scrub, on sandy, acidic substrates. On the interior, in [[thyme]] and clearings of xerophilic scrub, on marginal or calcareous substrates, somewhat decarbonated.<ref name="iucn status 20 November 2021" /><ref name=iucn />
